fact: ARCOP reports a World Bank-backed (PMADS) e-GP digitalisation of public procurement, with a preparatory workshop on 30 September-1 October 2025 on the e-GP strategy, phases and action plan.

Togo's procurement regulator ARCOP published a call in October 2026 to recruit four individual consultants to help set up the future electronic public procurement system (e-GP), with no go-live date given (Togo First).
